pokedexEntries.rb: A ferocious, prehistoric POKéMON that goes for the enemy’s throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.

pokedexEntries.ye: A savage POKéMON that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.

pokedexEntries.go: A vicious POKéMON from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.

pokedexEntries.si: This vicious POKéMON is said to have flown in ancient skies while shrieking high-pitched cries.

pokedexEntries.cr: In prehistoric times, this POKéMON flew freely and fearlessly through the skies.

pokedexEntries.rs: AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from genetic material extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies in ancient times.

pokedexEntries.fr: It was regenerated from a dinosaur’s genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.

pokedexEntries.lg: A ferocious, prehistoric POKéMON that goes for the enemy’s throat with its serrated, sawlike fangs.

pokedexEntries.em: AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.

pokedexEntries.dpp: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

pokedexEntries.hg: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.

pokedexEntries.ss: This vicious Pokémon is said to have flown in ancient skies while shrieking high-pitched cries.

pokedexEntries.bw: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

pokedexEntries.x: It was regenerated from a dinosaur’s genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.

pokedexEntries.oras: Aerodactyl is a Pokémon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from genetic material extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies in ancient times.

pokedexEntries.su: A Pokémon from the age of the dinosaurs. It used its sawlike fangs to shred its prey before eating them.

pokedexEntries.mo: In ancient times, it ruled the skies. A widely accepted theory is that it went extinct due to a large meteor impact.

pokedexEntries.us: Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokémon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.

pokedexEntries.um: It flew through the open skies over the ancient continent as if they were its own. When it touched ground, its walk was weak and slow.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: A savage Pokémon that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.

pokedexEntries.sw: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

pokedexEntries.sh: Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It’s a Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
